verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly document registered agents or authorized filers, so this axis applies. However, none of the evidence items mention registered agents, designees, authorized providers, or representatives who can file or act for a company. The pack covers only formation, annual reports, closure, certificates and in-person service.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
